issue:
Refactor CLI tests to call `main()` functions instead of calling the entry points 
CodeCov wants people to switch to their [binary uploader](https://docs.codecov.com/docs/codecov-uploader) instead of using the `codecov` package. However, in my tests (as part of #636), I found that when I switch to the new uploader, we were losing coverage – mainly because the [coverage subprocess measurement](https://coverage.readthedocs.io/en/7.2.7/subprocess.html) was not working as intended. 

Since we can't stay on the codecov python package forever, we will need to refactor our CLI tests so that instead of calling the entry point directly via `subprocess()`, we call the `main` function as we do in SKLL. 

There are two tasks in this issue: 
- [ ] Refactor CLI tests
- [ ] Switch to the binary CodeCov uploader
